description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat.

uses.name: Kami of Whispered Hopes
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater
